sloka: ननु ते राघवस्तुल्यो भरतेन महात्मना ।बहुशो हि स्म बाले त्वम् कथयसे मम ॥२-१२-२१॥
transliteration: nanu te rāghavastulyo bharatena mahātmanā ।bahuśo hi sma bāle tvam kathayase mama ॥2-12-21॥

translations.english: O childish one, you used to tell me several times that Rama is as dear to you as the highsouled Bharata.
